verdicts.reason: A: the symptom list is tiny and wraps wrongly ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache' each sit on one line, so six items look like four), and the doctor is a cramped sliver. Still, the hashtag badge, headline and yellow CTA are spaced cleanly and the CTA is readable. B has the same tiny, mis-wrapped list plus an orphaned 'cough' line, the hashtag badge jammed against the '6' of the headline, the sparkle floating away from the doctor, and a smaller CTA, so it is the less polished of the two.
